item.title: TSA temporarily closes Terminal C checkpoint at Philadelphia International Airport due to staffing shortages
item.description: PHILADELPHIA (WPHL) -- Travelers at Philadelphia International Airport may experience changes to security screening this morning after officials temporarily shut down the Terminal C checkpoint because of staffing shortages. The Transportation Security Administration announced the closure beginning Thursday, March 12, saying the move is meant to help optimize operations at other checkpoints throughout the airport. [...]

item.title: Gunman in Old Dominion University shooting served time for ISIS support, officials report
item.description: One person was killed and two others were hurt in a shooting at Old Dominion University on Thursday morning, according to officials at the Virginia school. The suspected gunman is also dead, the officials said.

item.title: Man who rammed his vehicle into Michigan synagogue was naturalized citizen from Lebanon, DHS says
item.description: An attacker armed with a rifle rammed his vehicle into one of the nation’s largest reform synagogues Thursday, driving through a hallway as security opened fire, fatally shooting him, authorities said.
